Coverage check

One checklist for both plans: every trade-off dimension, every affected group, and every part of today's system, each linked to where the current draft (the Germany-style hybrid) and the earlier single-payer plan cover it, plus automatic checks that every step, task, change, and money flow states its trade-off. The site will not build if any checklist link points at something missing.
